documented_expected_divergences: canopy_cover.all: known_divergent — Three independent divergences identified in the Gate 0 crosswalk: (a) C++ zeroes a tree's contribution when f_Hgt<=0 OR f_Dia<=0; Python excludes only dbh<=0/NaN and still credits crown area to a zero/negative-height tree; (b) Python's species-to-equation mapping depends on a caller-supplied tree_code_dict — with the default None, every tree is assigned equation 39 ('Other'), which does not match C++'s per-species FVS index lookup; (c) Python assumes one tree per acre per record while C++ callers supply an explicit per-acre count. None of these are numeric-tolerance-bridgeable; each requires a Python-side fix or an explicit input-contract change before any atol/rtol is meaningful.
